description: Chapter 7 - Addition of angular momenta. A book-led sequence for interactions, commuting observables, coupled bases, Hilbert-space expansion, Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, basis changes, magnetic moments and Hund's rules.

topics.title: Interactions between angular momenta
topics.note: Chapter 7 begins with Heisenberg, Ising, XY, antisymmetric, spin-orbit, local anisotropy and Zeeman Hamiltonians.

topics.title: Commutation relations
topics.note: Independent angular-momentum subspaces, total angular momentum, allowed l values and the projection condition m equals m1 plus m2.

topics.title: Vectors in the coupled basis
topics.note: The coupled basis is built by adding angular momenta pair by pair, either sequentially or non-sequentially.

topics.title: Hilbert space expansion
topics.note: Matrix expansion by tensor products makes angular-momentum operators act in the total Hilbert space.

topics.title: Local basis vs. coupled basis: Clebsch-Gordan coefficients
topics.note: Clebsch-Gordan coefficients relate local and coupled basis vectors and form the change-of-basis matrix.

topics.title: Basis change of an operator
topics.note: The Clebsch-Gordan matrix changes an operator from the local basis to the coupled basis.

topics.title: Application 7.A: Magnetic moment and the Zeeman effect
topics.note: Application 7.A derives the magnetic moment projection, the Lande factor and the Zeeman Hamiltonian in the coupled basis.

topics.title: Application 7.B: Angular momentum of atoms and Hund's rules
topics.note: Application 7.B applies angular-momentum addition to atoms, Hund's rules and Russell-Saunders notation.
